title: Home screen — glass and paper, ring and fan
question: The two materials you liked, in circles as well as the fan. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Glass ring
options.thesis: Clear glass spheres on a thin glass ring, a glass lens for Day's end, on an ivory-rose glow.
options.viewport: Ring centred, labels outside, glass capsule tab bar.
options.risk: The 'Now 21:40 - 3 of 7 lit' line is left over from the reference and would go.

options.label: Glass ring on your photo
options.thesis: The same glass ring over your meadow photograph, blurred into soft colour.
options.viewport: Photo fills the screen, white type, frosted spheres and lens.
options.risk: Depends on the photo; the app needs a good default when there is none.

options.label: Paper ring
options.thesis: Embossed paper discs on a debossed ring, a gold-foil seal for Day's end.
options.viewport: Serif greeting, ring of raised discs, foil-ringed seal in the middle.
options.risk: Paper texture must stay very fine on a real screen.

options.label: Paper fan, refined
options.thesis: The paper fan with a gold foil edge and more air.
options.viewport: Fan low on the screen, foil hairline on its rim, seal at the hub.
options.risk: The model still drooped the last sector; code draws it symmetric.
